title: NESTPAIR — Independent water and slow-feeding products for compact homes, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# NESTPAIR — complete client design records

## Product and identity

- Name: NESTPAIR
- Audience: compact households with adult domestic cats
- W: complete independent passive water vessel
- F: complete independent slow feeder with removable obstacle insert
- C: detachable connecting clip
- Operation: manual filling, emptying, separation and lifting
- In-use drinking and eating surfaces: open from above
- Family character: calm domestic forms, related rims, grips, seams and exterior finishes
- Open design choices: body silhouettes, slow-feed path, integrated grips, release details, material grades and manufacturing methods
- Existing geometric identity: the shared local side patch and recessed connection
- Name placement: board titles and presentation cover
- Physical-object branding: optional
- Additional fixed wording: Detach C before lifting

## Vessel dimensions

| Item | Geometry |
| --- | --- |
| W complete | Maximum 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm |
| F complete | Maximum 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm |
| Joined pair | Maximum 362 W x 180 D x 90 H mm |
| W-R | Unobstructed circular internal well, diameter 150 mm, depth 35 mm |
| W-R fill mark | Nominal 350 mL, below the rim; printed text: 350 mL |
| F-R | Circular internal well, diameter 140 mm, depth 25 mm |
| F-I | Removable; maximum rise 18 mm above F-R floor; every food path at least 12 mm wide |

## Eight-part inventory

| ID | Service part | Relationship |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W-B | Water base | Independent support for W-R; own side patches and pad |
| W-R | Removable water bowl | Upward removal from W-B |
| W-P | Removable water base pad | Dry-side attachment beneath W-B |
| F-B | Feeder base | Independent support for F-R; own side patches and pad |
| F-R | Removable feeder bowl | Upward removal from F-B |
| F-I | Removable slow-feed insert | Separately removable from F-R |
| F-P | Removable feeder base pad | Dry-side attachment beneath F-B |
| C | Connecting clip | Detachable connection between facing base recesses |

- Service-part total: eight
- W cleaning inventory: three parts, W-B, W-R and W-P
- F cleaning inventory: four parts, F-B, F-R, F-I and F-P
- Shared cleaning inventory: one part, C
- Grip and release features: integrated into the eight listed parts
- Independent use: W and F each upright and usable on its own base and pad

## Reversible local connection

| Feature | Record |
| --- | --- |
| Patch | Vertical flat, 36 mm wide x 20 mm high |
| Patch height | z = 6 mm at bottom; z = 26 mm at top; supporting plane z = 0 |
| Patch position | Both left and right sides of W-B and F-B, centred along each side depth |
| Recess | Horizontal open recess, 28 mm long x 4 mm high x 3 mm deep |
| Recess centre | z = 16 mm |
| Coupling clearance | 2 mm between facing connection planes |
| C release | Accessible, tool-free |
| Initial arrangement | W left, F right |
| Reversed arrangement | F left, W right, using opposite side patches |
| Handling sequence | C detached before either product is moved or lifted individually |
| Bowl access | Upward lift with base assembled; connection recess in dry exterior zone |

## Cleaning sequence

| Step | Action record |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Both vessels emptied |
| 2 | C detached; products separated |
| 3 | W-R lifted from W-B; F-R lifted from F-B |
| 4 | F-I lifted out of F-R |
| 5 | W-P and F-P removed from their bases |
| 6 | All eight parts separately accessible for hand washing and rinsing; wet surfaces openly accessible |
| 7 | Eight parts separately air drying, bowl interiors exposed |
| 8 | Dry W-P and F-P reattached to their correct bases |
| 9 | F-I seated in F-R |
| 10 | Each bowl returned to its own base |
| 11 | Both complete products individually placed, then reconnected |

## Material and finish proposals

- W-R and F-R: one shared proposed bowl material family
- W-B and F-B: one shared proposed exterior finish family
- F-I: separately identifiable, removable obstacle insert
- W-P and F-P: proposed non-slip elastomer parts on the dry side
- All eight parts: proposed material grade, surface finish and contact-zone assignment
- Contact-zone categories: intended water/food contact; dry exterior
- Material development topics: food-contact qualification, pad grip, clip retention and release
- Environmental savings and performance figures: open development topics

## Placement records

| State | Clear area | Arrangement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D1 daily pair | 400 W x 220 D mm floor mat | W left, F right; complete bodies within mat; bowls seated |
| D2 separated use | 900 W x 600 D mm floor zone | Independent W and F at least 300 mm apart between closest body edges; detached C visible nearby |
| D3 reversed pair | Same 400 x 220 mm mat | F left, W right |
| D4 wall-side use | Same 400 x 220 mm mat | Initial joined pair; at least 30 mm from rear body edges to wall; mat position accommodates clearance |

- Placement relationship: alternative arrangements of the same products
- Scene setting: neutral compact home
- Animal presence: optional

## Drying and cabinet records

| State | Clear area | Arrangement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DR1 drying | 500 W x 400 D mm draining surface | All eight parts separately accessible; bowls empty; F-I detached; bowl interiors exposed |
| DR2 alternate drying | Same 500 W x 400 D mm surface | Same eight parts; both bowls angled on their own rims with interiors exposed |
| ST1 storage | 400 W x 240 D x 160 H mm cabinet opening | All parts dry; W and F reassembled, unconnected and side by side; C beside them and separately retrievable |
| ST2 separated storage | Same 400 W x 240 D x 160 H mm opening | Same inventory; left/right positions reversed from ST1; C separately retrievable |

- Storage inventory: both bases, both bowls, F-I, both pads and C
- Storage support: each complete product resting on its own base and pad
- Cabinet and floor: neutral scene context

# NESTPAIR — local interface and client envelopes

## Side patch: W-B and F-B

| Element | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Patch | Vertical flat, 36 mm wide x 20 mm high; z = 6 mm at patch bottom to z = 26 mm at patch top above supporting plane z = 0 |
| Recess | Horizontal open recess, 28 mm long x 4 mm high x 3 mm deep; recess centre at z = 16 mm |
| Placement | Same patch on both left and right sides, centred along each side depth |
| Coupling | C engagement with facing recesses across a 2 mm plane-to-plane gap |
| C development | Exterior shape and accessible tool-free release |
| Handling | Individual lifting by each product after detaching C |

## Maximum envelopes

| Item | Envelope |
| --- | --- |
| W complete | 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm maximum |
| F complete | 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm maximum |
| Joined pair | 362 W x 180 D x 90 H mm maximum |

## Configurations

| Configuration | Arrangement |
| --- | --- |
| Initial | W left, F right |
| Reversed | F left, W right |
| Independent | W and F separately usable with C detached |

## Internal wells

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| W-R internal well | Diameter 150 mm; depth 35 mm; nominal fill 350 mL |
| F-R internal well | Diameter 140 mm; depth 25 mm |
| F-I | Removable; rise at most 18 mm above the floor; food paths at least 12 mm wide |

## Geometry scope

- Dimensions: nominal, in mm unless stated otherwise
- Fixed geometry: local connection patches, maximum envelopes and internal well dimensions
- Open design geometry: complete bowls, bases, slow-feed path and clip exterior
- Material scheme: proposed during design development

steps.userMessage:
NESTPAIR | Independent water and slow-feeding products for compact homes

Develop NESTPAIR as two complete, independently usable products: W, a passive water vessel, and F, a slow feeder with a removable obstacle insert, joined when needed by detachable clip C. Each product has its own base and removable pad. The family direction is calm and domestic, with related rims, grips, seams and exterior finishes. Develop the body silhouettes, feeding path and release details around the supplied side interface.

Each product fits within 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm; the joined pair fits within 362 W x 180 D x 90 H mm. W-R has a clear internal well 150 mm in diameter and 35 mm deep, with a nominal fill mark reading "350 mL" below the rim. F-R has a well 140 mm in diameter and 25 mm deep; removable F-I rises at most 18 mm above its floor and leaves food paths at least 12 mm wide. The complete service inventory is W-B, W-R, W-P, F-B, F-R, F-I, F-P and C. Both sides of each base carry a 36 x 20 mm connection patch with a 28 x 4 x 3 mm recess; C bridges a 2 mm gap. Start with W left and F right, then retain the same parts for reversal and separate use.

Print "NESTPAIR" in every board title and on the presentation cover, and "Detach C before lifting" on the assembly diagram and clip detail sheets. Propose specific material grades, finishes and contact zones for all eight parts. Bowl materials match each other, base finishes match each other, and the two removable elastomer pads sit beneath their respective bases.

Audience: households sharing compact homes with adult domestic cats, and our product and manufacturing teams deciding the range and preparing its development brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the component, cleaning, placement, drying and storage records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. interface.en.md records the vessel envelopes and reversible local connection. module-constraint.png locates the fixed envelopes, wells and side patches. local-interface-identity.png depicts the shared recessed side detail to retain across both products. compact-home-reference.png provides the warm, compact kitchen setting for placement scenes.

Deliverables:
1. One finished product drawing sheet with front, top and right orthographic views of the complete set, separate views of W, F and C, and dimensions for both wells, F-I and the joined envelope
2. One assembly and cleaning diagram covering all eight part IDs, upward bowl removal, clip release and the complete emptying-to-reassembly sequence
3. One material zoning board identifying proposed grades, finishes and water/food-contact or dry exterior zones for all eight parts
4. One D1 daily-use scene with W left and F right on the 400 W x 220 D mm mat
5. One DR1 drying scene with eight separated parts on the 500 W x 400 D mm draining surface
6. One ST1 storage scene with both dry products reassembled and unconnected, and C beside them, inside the 400 W x 240 D x 160 H mm cabinet opening

Acceptance:
- The product drawing sheet shows three corresponding orthographic views, the 180 W x 180 D x 90 H mm individual limits, the 362 W x 180 D x 90 H mm joined limit, both specified wells, F-I's maximum 18 mm rise and minimum 12 mm paths, and the 2 mm interface gap.
- The product drawing sheet and assembly diagram identify W-B, W-R, W-P, F-B, F-R, F-I, F-P and C consistently; the diagram follows emptying, clip removal, bowl removal, insert removal, pad removal, hand washing, rinsing, separate air drying and reassembly in that order.
- The material zoning board assigns a proposed grade, finish and contact zone to each of the eight parts, with matching bowl materials, matching base finishes and separate dry-side elastomer pads.
- The D1, DR1 and ST1 scenes fit their stated clear areas; D1 retains the initial W-left arrangement, DR1 exposes both empty bowl interiors and all eight parts, and ST1 places both complete products side by side with C separately retrievable.
- All six board titles contain NESTPAIR; the product drawing sheet shows the 350 mL mark below W-R's rim, and the assembly diagram prints Detach C before lifting beside the clip-removal step.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
